description: Chat over Matrix: read and send messages, manage rooms, reply in threads, and more.
long_description: matrix-mcp lets your assistant log in to a Matrix homeserver and drive most of what a full chat client can do: manage rooms and their membership, send and edit messages, react and reply, exchange files and images, look up profiles, hold direct-message conversations, and read/reply within threads. After installing, ask your assistant to run `login_sso` (or `login` for a username/password homeserver) to sign in, then `start_device_verification` to unlock reading encrypted history from before this device existed. End-to-end encryption is supported out of the box.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in with username/password. The session is persisted and reused on the next start.

tools.name: login_sso
tools.description: Log in via the homeserver's SSO flow: opens a browser, waits for you to finish signing in.

tools.name: login_with_token
tools.description: Log in with a pre-obtained access token, for headless/automated setups on an SSO/OAuth homeserver.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Log out, invalidate the access token, and delete the saved session and local encryption store.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Report the current login state (user id, device, homeserver, joined-room count, key-backup state).

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Run a single sync to refresh the local room list and state, and flush pending key-backup uploads.

tools.name: enable_key_backup
tools.description: Set up a server-side key backup and return a new recovery key.

tools.name: restore_key_backup
tools.description: Unlock the key backup with a recovery key, making pre-existing messages readable.

tools.name: download_room_keys
tools.description: Force-fetch a room's historical keys from the key backup.

tools.name: start_device_verification
tools.description: Start interactive (emoji/SAS) verification of this device against another already-verified session.

tools.name: continue_device_verification
tools.description: Continue an in-progress device verification, fetching the emoji once accepted.

tools.name: confirm_device_verification
tools.description: Confirm the emoji match, completing device verification and cross-signing.

tools.name: cancel_device_verification
tools.description: Abort an in-progress device verification.

tools.name: list_rooms
tools.description: List joined rooms with id, name, topic, and encryption state.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a room, optionally as a rich reply.

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit a previously-sent message (sender only).

tools.name: redact_event
tools.description: Redact (delete) a message, or a reaction to un-react.

tools.name: send_reaction
tools.description: React to a message with an emoji.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark a room as read up to a given event, or the latest message.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read messages from a room, in chronological order, with pagination.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one conversation thread: the root message plus its replies, oldest first.

tools.name: get_room_members
tools.description: List a room's members with display name, membership state, and power level.

tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Join a room by id or alias.

tools.name: create_room
tools.description: Create a room, optionally with a name, topic, invites, public visibility, encryption, or as a DM.

tools.name: invite_user
tools.description: Invite a user to a room.

tools.name: leave_room
tools.description: Leave a room.

tools.name: kick_room_member
tools.description: Kick a member from a room, optionally with a reason.

tools.name: ban_room_member
tools.description: Ban a member from a room, optionally with a reason.

tools.name: unban_room_member
tools.description: Unban a previously-banned member.

tools.name: update_room
tools.description: Update a room's name and/or topic.

tools.name: create_dm
tools.description: Get or create a direct-message room with a user.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Look up a user's display name and avatar.

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Upload a local file and send it as an image, audio, video, or generic attachment.

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Download the media attached to a message event to a local path.
